Applications in the Annex-AF proforma go by e-mail to [email protected] by 3:00 pm on 23 November 2026, and the notice states that applications received after the closing time will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: About NPC
content_sections.text: The National Productivity Council is an autonomous body under DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India, with its office at 5-6 Institutional Area, Lodhi Road, New Delhi – 110003. According to the notice, it promotes productivity consciousness in the country for sustainable socio-economic development through consultancy, research and training activities in different sectors of the economy.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are to be sent by e-mail to [email protected] . The notice names no postal address for applications. The subject line must carry the post code: "Application for Senior Consultant – C-01" or "Application for Senior Consultant – C-02". Fill in the application as per Annex-AF, the proforma enclosed with the notice. It asks for name, parent's or husband's name, date of birth, correspondence and permanent address, Aadhaar number, contact numbers, e-mail ID, the post applied for (C-01 / C-02 / both), qualifications and any other relevant information. Fill in the details of experience in APPENDIX-I of the proforma: period (starting from the last), name of office/organisation, post and remuneration or pay band with grade pay if applicable, and description of duties performed. Attach self-attested copies of the requisite documents and a latest photograph. E-mail the application to [email protected] with the post code in the subject, so that it is received by 3:00 pm on 23 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: For both posts the remuneration is determined by the marks awarded by the Selection Committee under AI No. 858/2026, and TA/DA for official tours is paid as per NPC rules. The notice sets the maximum age at 65 years for both posts; the age cut-off date and any age relaxation are not specified in the notice. Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Mining Engineering from a government-recognised University/Institution. Experience: 15 years and above in opencast mining; hands-on in HEMM operations and outsourcing contracts; experience in preparing/vetting SORs or estimates. Age: maximum 65 years. Desirable: First Class Mine Manager's Certificate; experience in contract management, estimation or productivity studies. Number of persons: 01. Contract period: 3 months. Qualification: CMA or B.E./B.Tech in Mining Engineering from a government-recognised University/Institution. Experience: 15 years and above in rate analysis, cost estimation, SOR/estimate preparation or contract costing of HEMM-based earthwork, mining or transportation works; strong in Excel-based equipment owning & operating cost models; ability to build variable cost models with escalation (price indices, wages, fuel/PV clauses). Age: maximum 65 years. Desirable: SOR/estimate preparation in opencast mining; price variation and escalation formulae; Excel-based cost models. Number of persons: 01. Contract period: 3 months. Working proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, e-mail and video conferencing. Own laptop. Physical fitness and willingness to undertake extensive travel and extended stay at mining locations. No conflict of interest. Candidates with the combined profile of both posts (B.E. in Mining with substantial experience in rate analysis, cost estimation or SOR work) will be given preference, and a candidate may apply for both posts. Candidates should check the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: NPC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The assignment involves development of Schedule of Rates (SOR)/cost-estimation models for opencast coal mining and allied operations. The scope broadly covers overburden removal and rehandling, silt removal, ripping/blast-free excavation, coal extraction, loading and transportation at different leads, crushing, coal and material handling, equipment deployment, lighting and pumping, and hiring of HEMM/vehicles. The work involves field studies at mining locations, review of existing SORs/NITs/contracts and operational records, time/cycle-time studies, equipment productivity and utilisation assessment, diesel/fuel consumption norms, manpower and machinery requirements, cost analysis, benchmarking, development of cost models and formulation/validation of SORs. Provide mining domain guidance for the field studies at the opencast mines. Validate HEMM productivity, cycle-time, utilisation and fuel norms. Review mining conditions, leads, gradients and strip ratios. Interact with mine officials on technical matters. Assist in formulating and validating SOR items and lead/price variation mechanisms. Review technical deliverables. Participate in technical discussions/presentations as required. Build cost models for each SOR item (owning and operating cost, fuel, manpower, repairs, overheads, profit). Convert time-study and productivity data into rates at different leads. Formulate lead variation and price variation clauses. Benchmark with SORs of CIL subsidiaries. Prepare working sheets and calculations that are traceable and auditable. Prepare technical deliverables. Participate in technical discussions/presentations as required.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the Annex-AF proforma. Self-attested copies of requisite documents, and a latest photograph. Details of experience in the prescribed APPENDIX-I. Self-attested copy of proof of date of birth. Self-attested copy of Aadhaar. For a retired person: date of retirement, name of the office where last working, and a copy of the PPO.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are first screened by a Screening Committee. Only shortlisted candidates are called for online/physical interaction before the Selection Committee. The Screening Committee screens the applications received. Incomplete applications will not be considered. The Selection Committee assesses qualification, relevant experience, subject knowledge, computer skills and communication skills. Candidates securing more than 80% marks will be granted the maximum remuneration, and those securing 60% to 80% marks will be granted 90% of the maximum, as per AI No. 858/2026. The notice does not give a date or venue for the interaction.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are vacant in NPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one for Senior Consultant – Mining Expert (C-01) and one for Senior Consultant – Rate Analysis & Costing Specialist (C-02), both at NPC Regional Directorate Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NPC Senior Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The last date is 23 November 2026, up to 3:00 pm. The notice says applications received after the closing time will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NPC C-01 and C-02?
faq.answer: C-01 needs B.E./B.Tech in Mining Engineering. C-02 needs CMA or B.E./B.Tech in Mining Engineering. Both must be from a government-recognised University/Institution, with 15 years and above of the experience described for each post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years for both posts. The notice prints no minimum age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an NPC Senior Consultant?
faq.answer: The remuneration is up to Rs. 1,10,000/- per month (Consolidated Fixed). The Selection Committee's marks decide it: more than 80% gets the maximum, and 60% to 80% gets 90% of the maximum.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the Annex-AF application with self-attested documents, a latest photograph and APPENDIX-I experience details by e-mail to [email protected], before 3:00 pm on 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What should the e-mail subject be?
faq.answer: The subject must mention the post code, as "Application for Senior Consultant – C-01" or "Application for Senior Consultant – C-02".

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected by NPC?
faq.answer: A Screening Committee screens the applications, and only shortlisted candidates are called for online/physical interaction before the Selection Committee. It assesses qualification, experience, subject knowledge, computer skills and communication skills.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job, and for how long is the contract?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely on contract basis for 3 months. It confers no right to regular appointment in NPC or its associated organisations.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for both C-01 and C-02?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice says a candidate may apply for both posts, and the Annex-AF has a "C-01 / C-02 / both" option. Candidates with the combined profile of both posts will be given preference.
